class.name: image_transport/dpred_pub
class.description: This plugin losslessly compresses 32FC1 and 16UC1 depth images with the dpred codec (value dictionary + 2D MED prediction + zstd).

class.name: image_transport/dpred_sub
class.description: This plugin decodes dpred-compressed depth images back to 32FC1 or 16UC1.
